cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ameth: Replaces a projectile with a native amethyst cluster. Retains native impact particles and sounds. Amplify changes damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lionf: Replaces a projectile with a native lionfish spike. Successful hits retain native Poison I for 3 seconds. Amplify changes direct damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bolt_: Summons a native lightning column at the selected location after a short delay. Amplify changes damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.increase_damag: Increases damage by the configured Harm amplification amount.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.decrease_damag: Decreases damage by the configured Harm amplification amount.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_: Raises a native Void Rune on nearby ground at the selected location, retaining its attack animation and damage timing. Amplify increases each hit by the same amount as Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flame: Erupts a native Flame Jet from nearby ground at the selected location. Retains native particles, sound and five-second ignition. Amplify increases direct damage by the same amount as Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cerau: Replace the projectile with Ceraunus. A single throw returns after impact; repeating carriers retain their trajectory.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wave: Replace a projectile with a wave that pushes enemies, extinguishes fire and applies Wetness. Lasts four seconds by default; Extend Time increases its duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.validation.modifier: This modifier requires a compatible projectile replacement.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.wave_duration_: Increases a native wave's duration by 50% of its base duration. Repeating carriers follow their own duration.
Decreases a native wave's duration by 50% of its base duration. Repeating carriers follow their own duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flare: Replaces a projectile with the Netherite Monstrosity's Flare Bomb. On impact, native flame jets spread outward in a cross. Amplify increases both direct and jet damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lava_: Launches the Monstrosity's lava bomb. Explodes on impact and leaves a temporary, non-spreading lava source.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_earth: Strikes and launches enemies around the resolved location, including the Boss's health-based damage. Ignites targets when the caster is at or below half health.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fissu: Sends a widening ground shockwave forward from the resolved location, lifting visual debris and knocking enemies back.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flame: Creates the Boss's paired expanding flame rings at the resolved location. At half health or below, the caster produces larger, denser rings.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_shoul: Charges toward the selected direction, knocking enemies back and inflicting Bone Fracture. Stops at obstacles. Allied entity targets perform the charge themselves.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lava_: Absorbs lava around the resolved location in three expanding waves. Each wave that consumes lava heals the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_monst: Grants an ally Monstrous: increased armor, toughness and knockback resistance, with periodic healing below half health.
